title: Tested MiniMax-H3 by feeding it my own pixel-art monsters — these play right before each stage's battle
author: Joeykiwis
selftext:
I heard MiniMax-H3 was putting out video on par with Seedance, so today I skipped game dev

and just ran video generation tests instead.

https://reddit.com/link/1vtesap/video/23jyws5x2ikh1/player

https://preview.redd.it/ej2z392y2ikh1.png?width=1092&format=png&auto=webp&s=8fd0c67530f770925bf985a7959540402e6da29c

For source material I used the monsters from my own game — the sprite-sheet characters I'd

generated with PixelLab.



The direction I gave was: make it feel like the player is marching in on that stage's tribe.

I had it write prompts to match that.



The game has 5 stages:



1. Goblin Tribe

2. Wraith Tribe

3. Forest Coalition (elves + fairy)

4. Mountain Tribe (dwarves, giants)

5. Human Kingdom



Stage 2 and 3 came out the best, so those are the ones I'm sharing.

https://reddit.com/link/1vtesap/video/xgcaz4203ikh1/player

https://preview.redd.it/kwmgjqo03ikh1.png?width=1092&format=png&auto=webp&s=6ceb57ccf889201e59d77a3036da17640363b9ca

These play right before the battle starts when you reach the stage.

comments.author: pirondi
comments.body: Cool experiment, i wonder how good could it be to create new ideas for characters and enviroriments.

replies.author: Joeykiwis
replies.body: Yeah, It has great potential, think about previous resource it takes to be this quality.

comments.author: Mindestiny
comments.body: Minimax H3 is super powerful, it's a shame their licensing is so restrictive.

replies.author: Joeykiwis
replies.body: You should try to get the license. It would not take that much long.

comments.author: Mauseleum
comments.body: Elf archons face needs a bit size increasing, otherwise nice sprites!

replies.author: Joeykiwis
replies.body: Thank you for the feedback! I did not recognize it!

replies.author: Mauseleum
replies.body: Are those sprites handmade? Because they look like they are, in a good way! And Im jelly!

replies.author: Joeykiwis
replies.body: No they are all generated with AI!

comments.author: CycleMother2006
comments.body: The initial intro and zoom-out are cool. I don't really understand the sudden jump back in though. I'd do one or the other. Jumping out just to jump back in immediately after doesn't feel like a natural camera flow. My two cents.

replies.author: Joeykiwis
replies.body: You mean, it does not have to be jump back in camera move right? My first version is with only initial intro and zoom-out style. But compare to this version, it was not dynamic.
